mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing clear skies over the Verona Area High School with a temperature of 53 degrees. The moon is currently in its First Quarter phase.

For city news, remember that VHAT is your go-to cable channel for local government meetings and community updates. Also, please review the city code regarding vehicle parking and storage, which requires vehicles to be parked on approved surfaces and sets limits on how many can be stored at your residence.
There is plenty to do today! Head over to Hometown Junction Park for the Verona Downtown Farmers Market, enjoy Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Louie, or join in for Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory.
In a noteworthy call from July 13th, officers responded to a passerby report regarding a vehicle stuck on a large rock, which resulted in the driver being arrested for a first offense O-W-I.
You are in for a treat with today's flavor, Mint Explosion. The shop is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM. If you are looking ahead to tomorrow, the flavor will be Really Reese's.
